title: Melania Trump launches new initiative to help children raised in foster system
summary: Donald Trump signed order creating ‘Foster the Future’ to develop opportunities and online hub for resources Melania Trump, the first lady, is spearheading a new initiative aimed at improving career and education opportunities for children raised in foster care. Her husband, Donald Trump, signed an executive order on Thursday that creates a “Fostering the Future” program that brings together federal entities, non-profits, educational institutions and the private sector to develop those opportunities for foster youth.
